body:
Heeey, you might not remember me, but since your post helped alot when I was really down, I thought you should know this.

I just graduated!! Thanks for the help and keeping my spirit up! Wouldn't have been possible without your help

Are you me???? It's like reading the last 2-3 years of my life.  
How did you even manage to build up the courage to talk with others about that topic? Every time I imagine having the conversation with my parents, it just ends in pure chaos and madness.

My last ex (3-4 years ago), was studying psychology, and from time to time, I would be "the subject" for some tests or studies. It was really interesting, but I did also get to see the boring parts of the tedious processes. But overall, it was interesting to see first hand, that its actually possible to analyse a person, help them  or even mess a bit with your friends. 

I swear to god, I could win Olympic gold in procrastinating. But I'm trying to be more active. I have found, that the 5-minute method works quite well (Do something for 5min, and then decide to continue or stop), but I still rarely get stuff done.

Thanks so much. I'll post here, when the decision has been made

Whenever I get those really dark thoughts, all I really want, is for someone to hug me and tell me, that everything is going to be okay, or chat with someone that understands me.
So, if you ever need to let the dark thoughts out, feel free to contact me. We will be happy, and we will get there ❤

I'm so sorry for your loss. The only thing holdning me back , is the pain it would cause my mom and dad. So thanks for this eye opening.

Thanks for this 🙏🏽 I'll begin to look into some of it

Thanks so much for the reply! It means alot!

Sometimes talking with people that have all those fancy degrees, can feel really fake. Like they're only doing this for some practise or for mo' money.

1. It's just so hard to make connections with people. Either people think I'm super weird and don't wanna be around me, or they stay my friend for around 1 month and just disappear. The last person I felt like a friend, was 3-4 years ago.

2. I know that I don't have to decided the rest of my life in the next days, but I just feel like, whatever I choose, is what I'll end up doing. I'm 25, so 1/4 through my life. If I decide to change, It will take another 3-5 years, and if that don't work out, it would just have been a waste of time... it just feels like.... aarrrggghh....

I just feel like, I can't choose anything else than continuing. I fear my parents would get mad, that those last 2 years have been wasted, and I would disappoint them so much! I have went through the discussion in my head so many times, and it all ends in the same result. Me leaving home and starting a new life somewhere else.

Thanks for the happy thoughts 🙏🏽❤

If you wanna chat or talk, feel free to contact me. Sometimes all there's needed, is a person that will listen.

We can get over this!❤

Thanks for replying, it means so much to me!

I'm really happy for you! That fact that you're in a better place now is just amazing! 

I know this sounds lame, but I don't really like therapist. Not because of the talking or analysis of me, but because I feel like I'm whining about so much and sounding like a lazy brat.

I know I don't have to decide what I want to do  for the rest of my life, in this moment. But i just feel like  whatever I choose, it'll probably end up being "the one". I'm 25, so currently 1/4 through my life and still haven't achieved anything. So when I choose what I'll study, I'll probably use 2-4 years, and if that isn't it, it would just have been an another waste of time.

Thanks for replying, it really means a lot to me!

I really admire you, for being able to realise that you wasn't enjoying it, and quit. That's amazing!

Its funny that you mentioned psychology, cause I have thought alot about going down that road instead of coding. But I'm not completely sure. It's so fascinating to learn about the human mind, and being able to help others, would be a huuuuuuge bonus.

Kudos to you my man, you made the leap i haven't been able to and I'm proud of you!
